Initial release of Budget Meal Planner — plan affordable, nutritious meals with efficiency and minimal food waste.

- Guides users in setting and sticking to a food budget based on household size, preferences, and available resources.
- Offers meal planning frameworks, efficient grocery list creation, and batch-cooking strategies.
- Provides tips to reduce food waste and avoid common spending pitfalls at the store.
- Focuses on cost-effective pantry staples, flexible meal structures, and smart ingredient utilization.
- Supports meal planning for individuals, families, and unique dietary needs without compromising on nutrition or satisfaction.
